claims.statement: For an exact-rank-three form A=RMR^T and a whole original-coordinate bank with collinear spectral rows of total squared weight lambda, if its compressed scalar quadratic coefficient a is nonzero, then ||p_Q||_infinity <= 16 sqrt(60) [lambda |a| |det M|]^(-1/4).

For two disjoint rank-one original-coordinate banks with invertible indefinite compressed block B, complete O3 bank mass mu through the two banks, and kappa=sigma_min(B), one has ||p_Q||_infinity <= 4 sqrt(20) 8^(1/4) (mu kappa)^(-1/4).

For a three-bank O3 packet of mass at least 1/512 with exactly one internally rank-at-least-two bank, the branch is paid below 405 whenever the compressed pair of the two rank-one companion banks has sigma_min at least 1/64. Any unpaid state also has both rank-one scalar-pivot parameters below 1/4096 and the product of their unscaled Rayleigh curvatures below 1/64.

Using account04/B19 adaptive Hausdorff-Young stability, the residual-diffuse null-coloop branch has continuous density bounded by 102 whenever e^-8 <= D_res <= 1; together with the partner endpoint and D_res>=1 estimate, D_res in {0} union [e^-8,infinity) is paid.

In the exactly-one-internal-rank-two O3 chamber, pay the simultaneous state sigma_min(B)<1/64, both rank-one pivot parameters <1/4096, and product of companion Rayleigh curvatures <1/64, uniformly through exact singularity and zero curvature.
